complement_note: ~3/yr: 21 residents over 6 PGYs in 2016-17; a 2026 RUHS paper (PMID 42255808, PMC13242277) tabulates 18 residents across 7 PGYs in one recent year; RUHS contributed 33 residents (5 women) to a 2015-2021 case-log study (PMID 37033513).
terminal_pgy_note: AOA era: 6 years (PGY-1 = osteopathic internship). Entry cohorts <=2013 finished after PGY-6 (Carson/Dahlin 2018, Duong at City of Hope 2019). From the 2014 cohort the ACGME 7-year track applies: a PGY-7 took part in a 2020 RUHS simulator study (PMID 33425512, 2014 cohort); Krel/Majeed started fellowships mid-2021; Bowen (2016 cohort) was PGY-7 in 2022-23 (PMID 36601142).

lineage_note: CORRECTION to phase 1: ARMC's 'Neurosurgery (AOA) Residency Program' (arrowheadregional.org 2025-26; PD Javed Siddiqi, coordinator Mariel Gray) is NOT this program. The RUHS ACGME program 1600500129 has PD Miulli and coordinator Jose Gonzalez at RUHS. The ARMC page is the AOA teach-out of the former Desert Regional Medical Center (Palm Springs) AOA program: its residents Houston, Arshad, Ramnot, Reier and Whitney publish as DRMC/'Arrowhead Neurosurgical Medical Group, Palm Springs' from 2020. PMID 37033513 treats RUHS and DRMC as two separate programs. Rebecca Houston (ARMC news, 2024-03, PGY5) therefore belongs to that lineage and was correctly left out of program 55.
